date.description: Session date (or date added to the bank), YYYY-MM-DD.

scenario.description: The scenario as posed (copy the bank title, or describe a new one).

scenarioId.description: Optional. id of the scenario-bank entry practised (data/scenarios.json), e.g. "S01". Must exist in the bank.

answer.description: Her answer. Empty or absent for scenarios not yet practised.

source.description: e.g. "48 Laws of Power, Law 1", "Chanakya Niti".
